method: Hash-verify archived plans, graph, coverage, manifests, receipts and predictions. Join exact original graph node IDs to new CONTROL_DEPENDENCE source/target sets. Fixed best and auxiliary last are separate.
limitations: Endpoint overlap is association, not proof that a new edge caused that node prediction.
Messages can propagate beyond direct endpoints; relation parameters, optimization and checkpoint choice can change predictions elsewhere.
Same filename is disambiguated by cohort and source SHA; no label reassessment was performed.
Counts are HCG-node CV validation, not deduplicated source-line F1 or independent test.
Small changed-node counts under a single seed do not establish semantic causality or broad generalization.
